scenes.headline: How one latent decodes a picture and its 3D
scenes.sub: Generate inside a geometry model's features, then read out both.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Nova! Most video generators paint pictures, then guess the 3D. GAE generates where geometry lives.

scenes.text: Generate in a latent that a geometry model can already read, then decode picture and 3D from the same state. The geometry never sees the picture.
scenes.say: Generate in a latent a geometry model already reads. Decode picture and 3D from that state. Geometry never sees the picture.

steps.say: Start with Depth Anything 3, frozen. It reads frames into four feature levels.
A codec squeezes those into sixty-four channels. Only the channels shrink, never the patch grid.
A flow model generates in that space: from noise, guided by a reference image and camera rays, to one latent per view.

scenes.label: condition number: raw Depth Anything level 3, then the 64-channel latent
scenes.say: The raw features' condition number is six point six times ten to the sixteenth: numerically singular. The latent's is fifty-three.

steps.say: To read a latent out, a shared trunk decodes it once.
One fork, a learned RGB head of two hundred and three million parameters, paints the pixels.
The other rebuilds four feature levels for Depth Anything's frozen head, which reads depth and rays.

steps.note: No path runs from the pixels to the geometry
steps.say: No path runs from the pixels to the geometry. Delete the RGB head and you'd get the same cloud, in grey.
In the paper's figure, the fork to RGB and geometry happens at the latent. The geometry head stays frozen.

scenes.title: Where every point comes from
scenes.say: Each point comes from the geometry readout alone.

parts.note: the camera centre, decoded from the ray
parts.say: Origin: the camera centre, from the decoded ray.

parts.note: metric depth from the frozen head
parts.say: Plus depth, from the frozen head,
times the ray's direction. The picture only sets each point's colour.

scenes.title: Picture and points, one latent
scenes.credit: authors' project-page render; qualitative final model

steps.say: The authors' render: pictures on the left; on the right, the point cloud decoded from the same latents.

scenes.text: Geometry is read, not reconstructed: picture and 3D fork from one latent, and the points never depend on the pixels.
scenes.say: Geometry is read, not reconstructed: picture and 3D fork from one latent.

recap: Generate inside Depth Anything 3's compressed features
One trunk, two heads: pixels and geometry
Points are origin plus depth times direction
scenes.say: To recap: generate where geometry lives, fork two readouts, build points from rays.
